text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"That hero... spurred his leaden body forward,
using his sword as a cane.
Yet, his progress was agonizingly slow..." huh...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... It's just like me right now...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, um...
I-Is there something I can help you with?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to the consecutive races,
fatigue seems to be catching up with her.
It might be best to review her schedule.
